title: The experiment order is complete only for the declared squared-loss target class
statement: For independent current scalar parameters and fixed independent local channels, learned variance u_i=Var(E[X_i|D_i]) gives Gain(f)=sum_(nonempty S)[partial_S f(m)]^2 product_(i in S)u_i for a fixed multiaffine target. Coordinate rho_i=u_i/v_i dominance is necessary/sufficient for every target in that class, not Blackwell order. For centered whitened finite features, B_i=Cov(E[phi_i|D_i]),0<=B_i<=I and Gain=c^T tensor_i diag(1,B_i)c-c0^2; coordinate Loewner dominance is necessary/sufficient over the FULL tensor-feature target span. Feature construction/whitening,local posteriors and contractions are paid; outcome-adaptive channels can break ex-ante tensor independence. Pairwise incomparable subset-reveal profiles give an exponential explicit Pareto list, not a lower bound against every compact optimizer.

requires: A COMMON fixed product prior with finite scalar variances, or centered square-integrable finite features with null directions removed and actual whitening paid.
Fixed independent coordinate-local experiments; same prior and feature system for the compared channels. Outcome-adaptive cross-coordinate channels are outside this order.
Squared-loss targets in the full declared multiaffine or tensor-feature span; necessary test functions must belong to that class.

assumptions: This is a decision-class-specific fixed-product order, not Blackwell order or a general adaptive ordering. Feature/posterior/matrix acquisition and contractions remain paid; an exponential explicit Pareto list does not exclude every compact optimizer.
costs: For fixed arity and budget B, source reports O(n 2^k B^k) arithmetic plus explicit gates/derivatives and O(nB) budget tables; at B2, O(N) construction/storage,O(h) real leaf/gate updates,O(Bh) plan recovery. This is not an O(h) update for the global adaptive first action.

Adaptive two-step query costs O(N+sum_i sum_(ancestors v)arity(v)), bounded by O(N+nkh), extra O(N) storage. Equally informed ordinary one-step compiler+hypothetical update/undo matches O(nh), with no new physical draws for hypothetical outcomes.

Synthetic depth8 workload uses65536 sources,21845 gates,65536 charged initial+2000 later observations,1000 fixed pairs and19 local target edits; build13.9003s,online5.2606s,16152 online gates,226128 candidate evaluations,258432 derivative entries. Changed targets prevent summing gains as one telescoping risk drop.

At the same final learner state, reconstruction costs11.3698s and adaptive query45.1596s for65536 first actions/3276800 conditional groups. Its gain is about2.84% above fixed-pair gain (not2.84% of total residual risk), with no new source calls; no total practical-efficiency win.

Reported complete replay JSON is delivered as a report, but uncertain raw history is not verified evidence or replayed by Capital. New PROOF/RUN files are distinct from the three earlier uncertain inference-frontier downloads.
